message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover for "TEMPO". The masthead is at the top in large black letters. Above it, white text reads "JEJAK GELAP HARUN MASIKU" and "DI BALIK LIMBAH NUKLIR SERPONG". A red vertical stripe runs down the left edge.

The central feature is a large architectural structure resembling the Monumen Nasional (Monas). It consists of a square white base, a tall gray tapering pillar, and a flat gray platform at the top with windows. Perched on this platform is a giant golden-brown, flame-shaped swirl with a texture resembling soft-serve ice cream or whipped cream. It sits on a square gold-colored base.

Surrounding the monument are several small, colorful electric race cars. These cars are scattered across a gray, textured surface with faint, zigzagging tire tracks. The cars are painted in various colors, including red, green, blue, yellow, and turquoise.

To the right of the monument, large white text reads "LAJU ZIGZAG FORMULA E", followed by a smaller block of text: "KAWASAN MONAS MORAT-MARIT AKIBAT PERSIAPAN BALAP MOBIL LISTRIK. TARIK-ULUR ISTANA DAN BALAI KOTA."

At the bottom right, date and price information is listed as "24 FEBRUARI-1 MARET 2020 RP 45.000 WWW.TEMPO.CO MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN ISSN: 0126 - 4273". A barcode and a QR code are visible0
